system.description:
Soldier-ascetics who fight in the field behind spear and shield, trading a little speed for a lot of staying power.

  • Armoured Discipline: You are trained in light armour and shields, and keep Fast Movement and the Deflect abilities while wearing light armour.
  • Your AC is 10 + the armour's bonus + your shield's bonus + half the Monk table's AC bonus (table AC minus 10, rounded down).
  • Dexterity does not add.
  • Spear Discipline: Stun Attack, Deflect Missiles and Deflect Blow work with a spear, staff or polearm you wield, as if unarmed.
